verdict.rationale: Otter documents an Android app to record, transcribe, and access meetings on the go. A community user describes recording voice journals in the iOS app, which corroborates mobile capture. Recordings become searchable transcripts that Otter AI Chat searches across. missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-person (non-call) capture, explicit statement that mobile recordings sync into the same shared workspace/Channels, first-party iOS app documentation.

support.subject: As a founder, I can record and transcribe in-person conversations from a mobile app, and those notes land in the same searchable workspace

citations.quote: Record, transcribe, and access your meetings on the go with the Otter Android app
One user relies on Otter exclusively for voice journaling.
Search your meeting transcripts across all time periods
Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps to instantly answer questions
